_comment: Known-vulnerable pinned dependencies, recorded 2026-08-17 when CVE scanning
was first enabled. This is a RATCHET, not an amnesty: scripts/check_audit_baseline.py
fails CI for any vulnerable package NOT listed here, and also fails if a listed
package's pinned version changes while still being vulnerable (i.e. someone bumped
it and it did not actually fix the issue).
Each entry records the version pinned in requirements.lock at baseline time and the
minimum version that clears its advisories. Delete an entry once its package is
bumped past 'fixed_in' and the audit reports it clean -- the script tells you when
These were NOT bumped on the spot deliberately: requirements.lock is pinned and this
project bumps in tiers by blast radius (a single big bump is what broke v7.8).
starlette in particular is a 0.41 -> 1.x major crossing that drags FastAPI with it
and needs its own soak. Renovate (renovate.json) will open these as individual PRs.

aiohttp.note: Mostly DoS-class (request smuggling, pipelined-request queue growth). Pulled in by pyTelegramBotAPI and used by the health/webhook server.

cryptography.note: HIGH: Bleichenbacher oracle in PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption. Major-version bump. RollCall does not use PKCS#7 EnvelopedData.

pillow.note: HIGH: decompression-bomb protection bypass via BdfFontFile. Used by utils/card_gen.py for match-day/receipt cards; inputs are bot-generated, not user-uploaded.

python-dotenv.note: MODERATE: symlink following in set_key. RollCall only reads .env, never calls set_key. Trivial patch bump.

starlette.note: HIGH: O(n^2) DoS via Range header in FileResponse, plus multipart DoS. Transitive via FastAPI -- bumping means bumping FastAPI across a major. Biggest of the six.

urllib3.note: HIGH: decompression-bomb safeguards bypassed in parts of the streaming API. Minor bump.
